meta.title: Portable church signal flow
meta.description: Starter: portable church set up and torn down every week. Road cases are containers holding the console, stage box, wireless, speakers on stands and the cable trunk; every item carries a load-in tag and a condition so the truck pack can be checked on a phone.

pages.title: Sunday set-up & power-up: Portable church
pages.summary: Roll the cases in, connect the few cables that matter and power up (about 25 minutes).
pages.body:
## 1. Load-in order

- [ ] [[device:port-case-stage]] and [[device:port-case-foh]] first, then [[device:port-cart-speakers]], [[device:port-case-wireless]], [[device:port-trunk-cables]], [[device:port-case-video]].
- [ ] Check every case against its contents list in the inventory (condition **poor** items get a photo).

## 2. Connect

- [ ] Two Cat6 reels: [[device:port-stagebox]] and [[device:port-mixer]] to [[device:port-sw]] (ports 1 and 2).
- [ ] Speakers on the stands; XLR from [[device:port-stagebox]] outs 1–3.

## 3. Power-up

- [ ] Switch on [[device:port-pdu]]; wait for the Dante LED on [[device:port-stagebox]].
- [ ] Power on [[device:port-mixer]] and recall scene **Portable AM**.
- [ ] Switch on [[device:port-spk-l]], [[device:port-spk-r]] and [[device:port-sub]] last.
- [ ] [[device:port-laptop]] to [[device:port-proj]]; focus the screen.
